quiesce.cpuBasis: os.cpus() tick counters, 3 s window, all logical cores (guard.ts formula)
quiesce.thresholdBasis: cpuBusyPercent (machine-wide; own processes cannot be separated here)

guardTs.basis: guard.ts readQuiesce rule: cpuBusyPercent <= threshold (no process list on this platform, as guard.ts)

quiesce.processListBasis: not read on Windows (docs/BENCHMARK_POLICY.md host rule: the power query is the only Windows-specific call); foreign chain nodes only by the port probe

portProbe.basis: TCP connect to 127.0.0.1, 400 ms timeout (refused or no answer = closed); the runner's own ports excluded

quiesce.visibility: Windows host: no process list; CPU busy is machine-wide (includes the WSL2 VM and any other load); WSL2 listeners on 127.0.0.1 are seen through localhost forwarding when it is on.
